csv_scope_of_work: This project consists of two primary components. The first includes the construction of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure and associated electrical, civil, demolition, and operational support work at the San Julian Bus Lot. The Work includes the installation of seventy-nine (79) electric vehicle charging stations, along with all supporting infrastructure, utility coordination, and site improvements. Second component involves long-term system maintenance services necessary to ensure reliable EV bus charging operations.
